## Goal
Update preplanning SKILL.md Context File Check (Phase A Step 3) to validate PIL fields against pil-handoff.md schema before using the context.

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md: in Phase A Step 3 (Context File Check), after parsing PREPLANNING_CONTEXT comment, validate each required PIL field against pil-handoff.md contract; fail-open on missing contract file; field mismatch -> emit PIL_VALIDATION_ERROR and halt

## Acceptance Criteria
- grep -c 'pil-handoff\|PIL.*valid' plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md should be at least 1
- bash tests/scripts/test-pil-handoff-integration.sh exits 0 (all 4 cases GREEN)

## Testing Mode
GREEN (instruction file update; depends S8B/T2)
